scope: small text quality probe, not formal W07 acceptance or human usability study
retryPolicy: no automatic retry; any correction/retest separately recorded max6
modelPolicy: use user configured model unchanged; record requested id, no paid judge
sampling: 3 intake candidate text snapshots + synthetic boundary cases; no images transmitted; 1 output per case

hardFail: unsupported major artist/year/material/location/intent asserted as fact

softScore0to2.grounding: 0 contrary facts;1 ambiguous scope;2 separates fact/interpretation/absence
softScore0to2.observation: 0 trivia only/answer forced;1 generic;2 concrete visible feature+open prompt
softScore0to2.continuity: 0 ignores given context;1 vague;2 uses observation and moves dialogue forward
softScore0to2.clarity: 0 confusing;1 verbose/jargon;2 beginner-readable and appropriate length

rubric.initialTargets: hard violations0/12; valid outputs12/12; <=25s per model call; guide1~3 paired questions; applicable soft scores mean>=1.5 (diagnostic, not population estimate)
rubric.comparison: Frozen non-model factual baseline below vs Q04 observation guide; Q02 explanation vs Q04 guide; Q10 easy vs Q11 deeper. Output review only, no human learning-effect claim.

factsProvenance: intake inventory 001/004/010 metadata candidates; visual notes from previous inspection; source approval remains pending
